name: settings-gone-sets
description: The host answers a snapshot whose common links name a set that the common sets lack; the page refuses the snapshot, sends no write of the settings, writes no record to the application log and sends no other call.
reason: The reply of the call workspace with the kind snapshot is the state of the registry, which the Go producer builds no project for (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#limits).
